generalAbilities.name: Sun Sense
generalAbilities.description: A flarysca can sense the presence of sunlight within 60 feet as a precise sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Lazy Sunlight
defensiveAbilities.description:
15 feet. Creatures other than the flarysca that enter or begin their turn within the aura must attempt a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, a creature becomes Clumsy 1, or increases it clumsy value by 1 if it was already clumsy.

If it was already Clumsy 2 or greater, it instead becomes Unconscious until it begins its turn outside the lazy sunlight aura. Creatures can't reduce their clumsy values while within the lazy sunlight aura.

On a critical success, a creature becomes temporarily immune to lazy sunlight for 1 hour.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Burst
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature interacts with or moves through a sunbeam containing a sleeping flarysca

Effect The flarysca startles awake, letting out a burst of fire as their body reconstitutes within the sunlight. The triggering creature and any other creature within 30 feet of the flarysca must succeed at a Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save or take 8d6 Fire Damage damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenate (Deactivated by Cold)
defensiveAbilities.description:
The flarysca has Regeneration 20 (deactivated by cold) while in direct sunlight. In addition to being deactivated by cold, this regeneration deactivates for 1 round whenever the flarysca takes an Attack action.

See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Creeping Warmth
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The flarysca shines brightly, increasing the radius of their lazy sunlight aura by 5 feet for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Light Jump
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The flarysca is standing within direct sunlight

Effect The flarysca teleports themself to another sunbeam or area of direct sunlight they can sense within 60 feet, with the effects of the translocate spell.
